sources.title: MiMo-V2.5-Pro-UltraSpeed launch
sources.evidence: June 8, 2026 launch with TileRT. Describes expert-only FP4 quantization-aware training and DFlash speculative decoding; says their checkpoint is open. Application-based API trial window starts June 9 Beijing time.

sources.title: MiMo-V2.5-Pro-FP4-DFlash checkpoint card
sources.evidence: Explicitly identifies this checkpoint as the model powering UltraSpeed. MIT metadata; backbone nominal 1.02T total/42B active and separate five-layer BF16 DFlash drafter. Released expert FP4 weights underwent quantization-aware training.

sources.title: UltraSpeed underlying backbone configuration
sources.evidence: 70 layers, 69 MoE layers, 384 routed experts with eight selected, mixed full/sliding-window attention, MXFP4 expert storage, max_position_embeddings=1048576. Text causal language-model configuration.

sources.title: DFlash drafter configuration
sources.evidence: Separate five-layer, hidden-size 6144 drafter, block size 8 and sliding-window 1024. Its configured max_position_embeddings is 262144; this is not used to override the backbone and product 1M context specification.

sources.title: UltraSpeed checkpoint chat template
sources.evidence: Processes text content, optional reasoning enabled by default, tool definitions, structured calls and responses; identifies the underlying model as MiMo-v2.5-pro.

sources.title: MiMo-V2.5-Pro-UltraSpeed product page
sources.evidence: Indexed primary page calls UltraSpeed an experience mode of V2.5-Pro and lists text input/output, Deep Thinking and Tool Calling. Current page says its limited beta ended. Direct HTML is a client-rendered shell; detailed product copy was available in the search index.

sources.title: UltraSpeed trial extension and ending notice
sources.evidence: Documents extension after June 23 and a later banner stating the limited trial concluded. Page update date September 8, 2026; no precise trial-closure date inferred.

sources.title: XiaomiMiMo UltraSpeed announcement via X syndication
sources.evidence: Official post timestamp 2026-06-08T14:37:21Z announces release of the exact UltraSpeed model with TileRT. Syndication returns only the initial portion of the long post; the blog separately provides complete technical and access details.

sources.title: Official checkpoint repository metadata
sources.evidence: Public ungated repository containing backbone, MTP and DFlash weight files. Created June 8, 2026, revision b754e6c86008bdb5cc901308dda5a38173ec7276. Creation timestamp alone is not used as public-release proof.

name.note: Public service name retained; its published checkpoint is MiMo-V2.5-Pro-FP4-DFlash.

developer.note: Xiaomi MiMo model team, with TileRT providing inference-system collaboration.

release_date.note: Original release announcement June 8 UTC, with open checkpoint linked in the launch article. Application-approved hosted trial starts June 9 Beijing time; this is not a general-availability API launch.

open_weights.note: Exact underlying FP4-QAT backbone and separate DFlash drafter are publicly distributed. Hosted trial access is separately restricted.

license.note: Checkpoint license metadata is MIT; this does not make TileRT infrastructure or hosted service terms MIT.

parameters_b.note: Author nominal count for the target backbone, not an exact combined count including the DFlash drafter or a storage-element count. Proposed backbone scope preserves that distinction.

active_parameters_b.note: Author nominal backbone active count; excludes speculative drafter work and is not a total for the combined inference system.

architecture.note: Hybrid-attention MoE target plus a separate dense block-diffusion drafter. Configuration has 69 MoE layers, 384 routed experts/top 8; quantization does not reduce the parameter count.

context_window.note: Backbone configured position limit; card advertises 1M. The separate drafter config says 262144; deployment example 65536 is a serving setting. No current endpoint operation claimed.

modalities.note: Exact product specifies text input/output and checkpoint template processes text. Remove unsupported multimodal description.

reasoning.note: Deep Thinking on the exact product page; checkpoint has a configurable thinking template.

tool_call.note: Product and checkpoint support tool definitions, structured calls and tool responses.

description.value: Text reasoning model using an FP4-quantized MiMo-V2.5-Pro MoE backbone and a DFlash speculative-decoding drafter.
description.note: Technical description replaces unsupported multimodality and subjective capability wording.

patch.description: Text reasoning model using an FP4-quantized MiMo-V2.5-Pro MoE backbone and a DFlash speculative-decoding drafter.

sources.label: UltraSpeed trial extension and ending notice
XiaomiMiMo UltraSpeed announcement via X syndication

patch.notes: Nominal 1.02T total and 42B active refer to the target backbone; the separate five-layer DFlash drafter and MTP weights are not reconciled into an exact combined parameter count. UltraSpeed uses separately published expert FP4-QAT weights plus the drafter, so it is retained as a distinct derivative despite experience-mode branding. Original announcement and linked open checkpoint: June 8, 2026; approved hosted trial window began June 9 Beijing time and was later extended, then ended. The backbone supports 1,048,576 positions; the drafter configuration separately lists 262144. Current availability of the former hosted endpoint is not asserted.

summary: Verified all 14 fields. Adds MIT, nominal target-backbone 1020B/42B and MoE architecture, with proposed component and phase scopes. Corrects multimodal description to text-only. Keeps June 8 announcement, distinguishing June 9 Beijing trial access. Retains separate release because the exact identified checkpoint includes FP4-QAT weights and a separately trained drafter; no catalog exclusion proposed. Complete system count and current hosted availability are not asserted.
